head: 74d1f0fcd3e65751ed49a024a7e04631ede7359e
scope: Architecture design only; implementation, delivered assets, lifecycle statuses, ADR acceptance, commits, pushes and merge untouched by this milestone.

coverage.requirement: Concrete core exports and compatibility/package delivery
coverage.result: Target ESM API, exact version/protocol checks, snapshot/runtime inventory integrity, host/version capability matrix and host-owned installation states specified.
Structured envelopes, criterion/test evidence, state digests, one recorder, publication retry, cancellation/recovery and separate human gates specified.
Explicit SessionAdapter methods and request/results; parent-to-worker lease delegation avoids recursive locking and prevents reclaiming a live worker from a dead parent PID alone.

coverage.requirement: Provenance across model switches and subagents
coverage.result: Action-time host capture, declared/unknown fallback, event transport/deduplication, repeated trailers, corrections/origin preservation and trusted-source validation specified.
Ownership digests, customized-file conflicts, links/containment, staged journal/recovery, host reload and command collisions specified; existing templates/pins remain unchanged.

coverage.requirement: Initial Codex surface and package interfaces
coverage.result: Repository skill and optional portable plugin layout, persistent NDJSON runner/core interface, CLI fallback and per-surface prerequisites specified. Native commands/background adapter remain unavailable.

verification.json_examples: 12 JSON fences contain 13 parseable JSON values; existing Claude registration fence is two independent snippets. Initial single-document check rejected that existing fence; stream parsing passed without changing it.
verification.lifecycle_statuses: All five edited architecture spec statuses match HEAD; no status transition made.
verification.implementation_tests: Not run: architecture-only milestone; CLI build and spec validation do not establish implementation conformance.
verification.live_host_tests: Not run; no tested Claude/Codex version matrix or live command/model/background certification.

new_overlay_warnings.rationale: Core-owned recording follows the shared deterministic boundary; the paired base sentence is a historical status comment.

new_overlay_warnings.message: `architecture/codex-integration` may contradict `architecture/agent-skills`: "Paths to these assets are relative to the installed skill, while repository p..." (overlay) vs "Skills must never hardcode paths." (base).
new_overlay_warnings.rationale: Package-relative assets differ from repository spec/plan/ADR paths, which still resolve from config.

deferred: Human review of architecture text and separate explicit lifecycle approval/ADR acceptance decisions.
Commit settled spec content before refreshing dirty-target dependency pins; do not pin uncommitted content.
Implementation planning and changes to core, adapters, installers, procedures, templates and contract pins follow architecture review.
Run implementation and per-host/surface integration verification against named versions before enabling native/background capabilities.
Keep prior contextual warning dispositions scoped to their reviewed snapshots; do not suppress warnings or refresh delivered skill pins as a conformance claim.
